title: Public Finance & Fiscal Federalism Reference Records (India - Maharashtra - Nashik)

meta.caveat_notice: Official fiscal figures represent institutional statutory allocations and audited disbursements under the Constitution and Financial Codes. Public funds are governed by executive rules and appropriation acts; individual legislators or officers do not possess arbitrary personal budget discretion.

fiscal_architecture_summary.constitutional_basis: Articles 268-293 of the Constitution of India define the fiscal relationship between Union and States. 73rd and 74th Amendments (Articles 243H, 243I, 243X, 243Y) establish local government financial powers and State Finance Commissions.

flow_of_funds.instruments: Gross Tax Revenue (Direct & Indirect Taxes, GST, Customs, Corporation Tax, Income Tax), Non-Tax Revenue, Disinvestment
flow_of_funds.distribution_channel: Devolution of Central Taxes (Article 270) based on Finance Commission recommendations (41% net divisible pool), plus Centrally Sponsored Schemes (CSS) and Central Sector Schemes.

flow_of_funds.instruments: State Own Tax Revenue (State GST, State Excise, Stamp Duty & Registration, Taxes on Vehicles, Electricity Duty), Non-Tax Revenue, Share in Central Taxes, Grants-in-Aid from Union (Article 275).
flow_of_funds.distribution_channel: State Budget appropriations via Annual Financial Statement (Article 202); allocations to State Departments, District Annual Plan (DPDC), and Statutory Local Bodies.

flow_of_funds.instruments: Own Revenues (Property tax, user charges, water cess, trade licenses, building permission fee) PLUS Intergovernmental Transfers: (1) 15th Finance Commission Tied & Untied Grants, (2) State Finance Commission recommendations, (3) Stamp duty surcharges, (4) Specific scheme grants (JJM, AMRUT, Swachh Bharat).

records.source_name: Ministry of Finance, Government of India - Union Budget Receipts Budget (Statement 2)
records.caveat: Determined by XV-FC formula: Population (15%), Area (15%), Forest & Ecology (10%), Income Distance (45%), Tax Effort (2.5%), Demographic Performance (12.5%).

records.category: Central Assistance for State Plans & CSS
records.source_name: Union Budget - Statement 9: Transfer of Resources to States and UTs
records.caveat: Includes central matching shares (60:40 or 50:50) for Jal Jeevan Mission, Samagra Shiksha, National Health Mission, and PMGSY rural roads.

records.category: 15th Finance Commission Rural Local Body Grants
records.source_name: Finance Commission of India / Ministry of Panchayati Raj eGramSwaraj portal
records.caveat: 60% Tied: specifically ring-fenced for rural drinking water, rainwater harvesting, greywater management, and ODF-Plus sanitation; 40% Untied for local civic priorities.

records.category: 15th Finance Commission Urban Local Body Grant
records.source_name: Finance Commission of India - Million Plus Cities Challenge Fund Allocation
records.caveat: Performance-linked to National Clean Air Programme (NCAP) ambient particulate reduction and water-recycling benchmarks.

records.entity: District Planning and Development Committee (DPDC) Nashik
records.source_name: Planning Department, Govt of Maharashtra / Nashik District Collectorate
records.caveat: Statutory body under Article 243ZD; consolidates draft district plan for rural panchayats and municipalities across Nashik.

records.entity: State Bank of Government of Maharashtra (RBI Managed)
records.category: Ways and Means Advances (WMA) & Overdraft Limit
records.source_name: Reserve Bank of India - Monetary Policy & Financial Markets Operations
records.caveat: Short-term temporary liquidity cushion to bridge intra-year mismatches between receipts and disbursements; strictly financial management, not departmental budget.
